'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghan conflict]]
**At least three people are killed and seven others are injured by an [[explosion]] at a hotel in [[Khost]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-khost-hotel-explosion-22ca61cffbe16b10157c64feee23872c (AP)]
*[[Libyan Crisis (2011–present)|Libyan Crisis]]
**Fighting breaks out in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]] between the 444 [[brigade]] and the [[RADA Special Deterrence Forces|Special Deterrence Force]] after the head of the 444 brigade was allegedly detained by the Special Deterrence Force at an airport in Tripoli. Twenty-seven people are killed and more than 100 injured. [https://apnews.com/article/libya-militia-fighting-violence-6b79fc951a1bd4e3621ef59c3ad8301d (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Bombing of Odesa (2022–present)|Bombing of Odesa]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] strike [[Odesa]] with missiles and [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]], injuring three people and damaging [[civilian]] infrastructure. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-08-14-23/h_41e28d20cc1e50a81bafd3609ebdf1b5 (CNN International)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**A report to the [[United Nations Security Council|UN Security Council]] finds that the [[Islamic State]] still commands between 5,000 and 7,000 members across [[Syria]], [[Iraq]] and [[Afghanistan]], posing a serious threat to the region despite the imposition of [[economic sanctions]]. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-fighters-syria-iraq-875d5ee8a0978f3b28aeec210b33cd5f (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022–2023 food crises]]
**[[France]] announces that supermarket prices increased 13.1% year-on-year in July according to the [[Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques|national statistics bureau]]. [https://www.insee.fr/en/statistiques/7658084 (INSEE)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**Shares in [[Hawaiian Electric Industries]] drop 30% after the company was sued for refusing to shut down [[power line]]s. Lawsuits are also filed against three other power companies that oversee [[List of United States electric companies#Hawaii|the state]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/08/14/hawaiian-electric-shares-dive-40percent-following-class-action-lawsuit-.html (CNBC)] [https://radaronline.com/p/maui-wildfire-lawsuit-lahaina-couple-sue-power-companies-ignoring-sign/ (Radar Online)]
**The [[wildfire]]s in [[Maui]], [[Hawaii]], [[United States]], are ranked as the fifth deadliest wildfire in American history. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/maui-wildfire-now-ranks-deadliest-us-history/story?id=102249625 (ABC News)]
*[[2023 Makhachkala gas station explosion]]
**At least 35 people are killed and 80 others are injured in an explosion at a [[gas station]] in [[Makhachkala]], [[Dagestan]], [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-explosion-dagestan-0565233354e942ad1481eb5ade1aa53c (AP)]
*[[2023 Tunisia migrant boat disasters]]
**Five people are killed and seven others missing after a boat carrying 35 migrants from [[Sfax]], [[Tunisia]], [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|sinks]] in the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20230814-five-dead-seven-missing-as-migrant-boat-sinks-off-tunisia (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Land mines in Cambodia]]
**A [[secondary school]] in [[Kratié province|Kratié]], [[Cambodia]], once a [[supply depot]] during [[Cambodian Civil War|the country's civil war]], temporarily closes after over 2,000 pieces of [[unexploded ordnance]] are found. [https://apnews.com/article/cambodia-unexploded-ordnance-school-8aa6f62853f7b81a3c45d49c87718f5f (AP)]
*[[2023 Hpakant jade mine disaster]]
**At least 25 miners are killed and 14 others missing after a [[landslide]] at a [[jade]] [[mining|mine]] in [[Hpakant]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/25-dead-after-myanmar-jade-mine-landslide/articleshow/102750676.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]
*Eleven people are killed, ten missing and 30 others are injured in an explosion at a market in [[San Cristóbal, Dominican Republic|San Cristóbal]], [[Dominican Republic]]. [https://apnews.com/article/dominican-republic-explosion-dead-san-cristobal-9a51f508e563c3ba211eaa1fd46bbfbf (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed and nine others are injured in a collision between a truck and a minibus near [[Lanjik]], [[Armenia]]. [https://www.azatutyun.am/a/32546866.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[Minister of Health (New Zealand)|Health Minister]] [[Ayesha Verrall]] announces [[New Zealand]] will end [[COVID-19]] restrictions including [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandates]] and 7-day quarantines. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-removes-final-covid-19-restrictions-2023-08-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Georgia election racketeering prosecution]]
***Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and eighteen associates{{snd}} including former [[White House Chief of Staff]] [[Mark Meadows]] and former [[United States Department of Justice|Justice Department official]] [[Jeffrey Clark]]{{snd}}are indicted in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] by [[Fulton County, Georgia|Fulton County]] District Attorney [[Fani Willis]] as part of an [[2020 Georgia election investigation|investigation]] into their alleged involvement in attempting to overturn the [[2020 United States presidential election|election results]] in [[2020 United States presidential election in Georgia|the state]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-georgia-election-investigation-grand-jury-willis-d39562cedfc60d64948708de1b011ed3 (AP)] 
*[[Murder of Agnes Wanjiru]]
**[[Government of Kenya|Kenya]] launches an [[Public inquiry|inquiry]] into [[British Army Training Unit Kenya]], amid allegations of [[murder]], [[sexual abuse]], and damage to land near the [[military base|base]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2023/aug/14/kenya-launches-inquiry-into-claims-of-abuse-by-british-soldiers-at-training-unit (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Terrorism in France]]
**[[Ministère public (France)|Prosecutors]] announce that [[National Police (France)|police]] are investigating [[bomb threat]]s at the [[Eiffel Tower]] in [[Paris]] that resulted in two [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]] on Saturday. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/14/world/france-probes-false-bomb-threats-at-eiffel-tower/1905363 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**The [[District Attorney of Philadelphia|Philadelphia District Attorney]] and [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] announce charges against a 17-year-old [[Philadelphia]] resident for allegedly plotting [[terrorism]] on behalf of an [[al-Qaeda]]-linked group. [https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/fbi-in-philadelphia-17-year-old-terrorism-arrest/ (CBS News)]
*[[Government of Poland|Polish]] [[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] announces a [[referendum]] on the acceptance of "thousands of [[illegal immigrants]] from the [[Middle East]] and [[Africa]]" as part of a [[European Union]] [[Migration and asylum policy of the European Union|relocation plan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-migration-referendum-election-e43f5f5f76a34a6f7f3a24b3d39fbc00 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Government of Latvia|Latvian]] [[Prime Minister of Latvia|Prime Minister]] [[Krišjānis Kariņš]] announces his [[resignation]] and says his [[Second Kariņš cabinet|government]] will step down this week citing a breakdown in relations within his multi-party government. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/latvian-prime-minister-announces-resignation-2023-08-14/ (Reuters)]
